test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 1st December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The average of nine numbers is 20.6. The average of three of them is 26.1, while the average of another three of these numbers is 15.2. What is the average of the remaining three numbers?
solution:
**Formula:**

Average = Sum of the numbers/Total numbers

Calculation: 

Sum of 9 numbers = 20.6 × 9 = 185.4

Sum of 3 numbers of them = 26.1 × 3 = 78.3

Sum of another 3 numbers = 15.2 × 3 = 45.6

The Sum of remaining three numbers = 185.4 - (78.3 + 45.6) = 61.5

⇒ Average of remaining three numbers = 61.5/3 = 20.5

∴ The average of remaining three numbers is 20.5.
